scenarios.text: A user with a peanut allergy asks for a protein or snack bar for an afternoon snack.
A user with a tree nut allergy asks for a protein or snack bar under NZ$4.00.
A user with a milk allergy asks for a breakfast cereal.
A user with gluten intolerance asks for a breakfast cereal with 10g of sugar or less per serving.
A user with gluten intolerance asks for a pasta or noodle product under NZ$3.00.
A user with an egg allergy asks for a pasta or noodle product that can be prepared in 10 minutes or less.
A user with a sesame allergy asks for a lunchbox snack.
A user with milk and peanut allergies asks for a lunchbox snack under NZ$5.00.
A user with a soy allergy asks for a plant-based or dairy-free alternative.
A user with milk and tree nut allergies asks for a plant-based or dairy-free alternative.
